tools.name: generate_study_plan
tools.description: Create a personalized week-by-week study plan for a student from their syllabus, exam topics, or a description of what they need to study. tools.name: generate_thesis_statement
tools.description: Generate strong thesis statement options for an essay from a topic, the essay type (argumentative, expository, analytical, compare-contrast), and an optional stance. Requires the student’s email. Free. Use it when a student needs a thesis or essay direction.

tools.name: generate_citation
tools.description: Generate a formatted citation for a source in five styles (APA, MLA, Chicago, Harvard, IEEE) from the source type and details. Requires a student email. Free. Use it when a student needs to cite a book, journal article, website, or other source for an essay or paper.

tools.description: Ask the ScholarNet AI Tutor a question and get a step-by-step explanation, on the connected student account (counts toward their plan). tools.name: generate_quiz
tools.description: Generate a practice quiz on a topic for the connected student, saved to their ScholarNet account. Requires a connected ScholarNet account.

tools.name: generate_flashcards
tools.description: Generate a set of study flashcards from a topic or from pasted notes, saved to the connected student ScholarNet account. Requires a connected ScholarNet account.
